page.layout: One column of text, with Arabic and Latin lines mixed, at left; marginal references in the right margin beside the lines "Cursus" and "peregrinanti"; running head top centre; page number top right; catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: [?] معه على العقل فلا يظهر به كمال الرق والانقياد Quod ad discursum illum repetitum, & jactum lapillorum, & reliquas hujusmodi actiones, nihil hac ad animum hominis, nec consentanea natura; nec est intellectui quo ad inquirendum quid hac sibi velint, dirigatur, nec quod quempiam ad ea amplectenda incitet, verum mandato simplici constant, & intentione merâ obsequendi mandato, quatenus mandatum est cui necessario parendum sit, & cui se immiscere, intellectui non sit concessum, & à cujus usu familiari alieniores sint natura & animus. Cum enim percipit intellectus rei alicujus scopum, fit aliquo modo natura ad eam propensior, quae propensio suppeti-as fert mandato, unaque cum eo intellectum adortitur, adeo ut non appareat in eo plena servitus & obedientia.

Cursus [?] السعي ]sc inter.{*} Safa & Marwah, inter quae peregrinanti septies discurrere, idque partim [?] علی gravitate confuetâ, partim [?] *v. p. 128. [?] gressu citato pars hujus cultus est. [?] يفعل ذلك سبعا ويرمل [?] في موضع الرمل في كل مرة ويسكن في موضع السكون Septies hoc faciet, & unaquaque vice festinabit ubi festinandum est, & lentè incedet, ubi lento gressu incedendum est, inquit AlGazalius, ritus istos describens.

Et properatio in circuitione Caaba Quod nostèr vocat [?] هرولة illud alii vocant [?] الرمل . Eadem utriusque vocis significatio, scil. Gressus concitatior, [?] الاسراع في المشي مع تقارب الخطا وهو دون العدو وفوق المشي المعتاد explicante AlGazalio, i. e. Properatio inter

page.notes: Arabic lines are copied as far as legible; every Arabic word is uncertain and marked [?]. The italic/roman boundary within the first Latin paragraph is uncertain. The signature "S f 2" is read as "Ss 2" (long s given as a plain s). The "]sc" after "Cursus" may be a printed bracket or a damaged word. The Arabic word after "gressu" and the Arabic fragments in the middle lines are not clearly legible. Printed hyphen kept in "suppeti-as". The right margin holds two references: "Ib. l. 7." beside the "Cursus" line and "*v. p. 128." beside the "peregrinanti" line, which carry the mark "*".
